name: self-test-node-build-violation
description: Round-5 fixture (issue #23): closes the npm-build swallow-regression residual recorded since C1. Declares ONLY a `build` script, which deliberately exits 1 -- no lint/typecheck/test scripts exist, so the reusable workflow's jq existence checks skip those steps and `npm run build` is the only step that can plausibly fail. The residual was recorded as hard because `--if-present` made a build-only failure awkward to construct; the jq existence gate the workflow now uses makes it straightforward. Expected to FAIL, with an inverted assert job.
